effects: The signer sends `assets` USDC from their wallet to the vault (safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets) in enter).
The vault mints previewDeposit(assets) shares to `onBehalf`. The share amount comes from the share price in storage, and the code sets no minimum.
accrueInterest runs first. It may mint fee shares to the fee recipients and may book losses, which changes the share price the signer gets.
formats.shown: The screen says it deposits the stated USDC amount and sends infinifiUSDC shares to `onBehalf`. It does not say how many shares.

findings.title: deposit shows the share ticker 'infinifiUSDC', but the vault token's on-chain symbol is 'bbqUSDCinfinifi'.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json metadata.constants.vaultTicker = "infinifiUSDC", shown as the 'Share ticker' field. In case 0 the minted share transfer reads symbol "bbqUSDCinfinifi" from the vault 0xbeeff…4931. VaultV2.sol has `string public symbol;`, which the owner sets.
findings.fix: Set vaultTicker to the on-chain symbol "bbqUSDCinfinifi", or remove the raw ticker field and name the vault in the intent.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many shares the signer receives, and the code sets no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. The share count comes from storage. In case 0 the signer received 0.01 shares, and no field states this.

findings.title: deposit adds a fixed 'Share ticker' raw field that holds no transaction data.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit field {"label": "Share ticker", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"}. Case 0 renders 'Share ticker: infinifiUSDC'.
findings.fix: Fold the ticker into the label, for example 'Send infinifiUSDC shares to'.

cases.notes: The 0.01 USDC out is shown right. The shares in go to the signer (onBehalf), but the amount is not shown, and the ticker differs from the on-chain symbol bbqUSDCinfinifi.

effects: The signer pays previewMint(shares) USDC from their wallet to the vault. The amount comes from the share price in storage, and the code sets no maximum.
The vault mints exactly `shares` vault shares to `onBehalf`.
accrueInterest runs first and may change the share price, which changes how much USDC the signer pays.
formats.shown: The screen says it mints the stated number of infinifiUSDC shares to `onBehalf`, and a 'Deposit asset: USDC' field names the token paid. It shows no USDC amount.

findings.title: The mint intent and sentence do not say the signer pays USDC. Only a raw ticker field hints at it.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint: intent "Mint", interpolatedIntent "Mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}". VaultV2.enter: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets);`. In case 1 the signer pays 1.002188 USDC. The reader was unsure of the amount and thought the address looked like a burn.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Pay USDC to mint vault shares" and the interpolatedIntent to "Pay USDC to mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}".

findings.title: mint does not show the USDC amount taken from the signer, and the code sets no maximum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.mint: `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. The amount is not in calldata. In case 1 the signer paid 1002188 USDC units (1.002188 USDC), and the screen shows only 'Deposit asset: USDC'.

cases.notes: The screen names USDC as the asset paid but not the amount (1.002188 USDC). The shares go to 0x…dEaD, not to the signer.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns previewWithdraw(assets) shares from `onBehalf`. The share count comes from storage, and the code sets no maximum.
When the signer is not `onBehalf`, the call spends the signer's share allowance from `onBehalf`.
`receiver` gets exactly `assets` USDC from the vault.
formats.shown: The screen says it withdraws exactly the stated USDC amount to `receiver`, from the shares of the named Owner. It does not say how many shares are burned.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many shares it burns from the owner, and the code sets no maximum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);` then `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. In case 2 the call burns 24854.04 shares from the signer, and nothing on the screen states this.

cases.notes: The share burn (24854.04 bbqUSDCinfinifi out) is not shown, and the reader inferred only that their position goes down. The 24871 USDC in to the signer is shown right.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` shares from `onBehalf`. When the signer is not `onBehalf`, this spends the signer's share allowance.
`receiver` gets previewRedeem(shares) USDC from the vault. The amount comes from the share price in storage, and the code sets no minimum.
accrueInterest runs first. A loss it books lowers the USDC paid out.
formats.shown: The screen says it redeems the stated number of shares to `receiver`, with the named Owner. It never says that USDC is paid out or how much.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset the receiver gets. The reader could not tell what arrives.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem fields are only 'Shares to redeem', 'To' and 'Owner'. The interpolatedIntent is "Redeem {#.shares} to {#.receiver}". VaultV2.exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);`. In case 3 the signer received 170.174281 USDC, and the reader wrote 'Unknown asset and amount'.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}. Change the interpolatedIntent to "Redeem {#.shares} for USDC to {#.receiver}".

findings.title: redeem does not show the USDC amount received, and the code sets no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);`. The amount is not in calldata. In case 3 the signer received 170174281 USDC units (170.174281 USDC).

cases.notes: The 170.0877 shares out are shown right. The 170.174281 USDC in goes to the signer, as shown, but neither the asset nor the amount is shown.
